ui.tooltip: God's Eye View — Real-time 3D Globe, ADS-B Flight Radar, Live CCTV, Satellites & Shaders

agentGuide: Use flyTo to fly the 3D globe camera to a city preset (nyc, london, tokyo, paris, sf, dubai, dc, austin) or any place query.
Use setLayers to enable or disable live OSINT feeds (flights, military, cctv, satellites, ais-live-vessels, submarine-cables, earthquakes, firms, weather, wind, radio).
Use controlCctv with action 'nearest', 'next', or 'select' to open a live CCTV camera stream and 3D viewshed cone.
Use setOptics to switch the post-processing shader (normal, retro, surveillance, thermal, noir, anime, snow).
Submarine cables require user acceptance of the CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 license via acceptLicensePack.

agentActions.summary: Read active 3D globe state, enabled live layers, optics shader, tracked entity, and CC BY-NC license status.
Fly the 3D globe camera to a city preset ('nyc', 'london', 'tokyo', 'paris', 'sf', 'dubai', 'dc', 'austin') or any place query.

locationId.description: City preset: nyc, london, tokyo, paris, sf, dubai, dc, austin

query.description: Free-text place or landmark query (e.g. Manhattan, Strait of Hormuz, Shibuya)

agentActions.summary: Enable or disable live OSINT layers (flights, military, cctv, satellites, ais-live-vessels, submarine-cables, earthquakes, firms, weather, wind, radio).

layerId.description: Layer ID to toggle (flights, military, cctv, satellites, ais-live-vessels, submarine-cables, earthquakes, firms, weather, wind, radio, traffic, transit)

enabled.description: True to enable (default), false to disable

agentActions.summary: Switch the post-processing optical shader (normal, retro, surveillance, thermal, noir, anime, snow).

style.description: Optical mode: normal, retro, surveillance, thermal, noir, anime, snow

agentActions.summary: Control live CCTV webcam feeds and 3D viewshed cones (enable, disable, nearest, next, prev, select, focus, viewshed, projection, autohop).

cameraQuery.description: Camera name or road query when action is select

enabled.description: Optional toggle state for viewshed, projection, or autohop

agentActions.summary: Control global live internet radio (enable, disable, play, pause, next, previous, select, status).
Lock onto the nearest live civil or military aircraft on the 3D radar.
Track a specific aircraft callsign, satellite, or vessel by query, or stop tracking.

query.description: Callsign, hex, vessel, or satellite name (e.g. ISS)

layerId.description: Optional layer hint (flights, military, satellites, ais-live-vessels)

agentActions.summary: Enter or exit 3D first-person Cockpit mode aboard a live aircraft.
Toggle the 3D Cyber Sonar infrastructure pulse overlay.

enabled.description: True to enable Cyber Sonar pulse

agentActions.summary: Open or close a HUD panel (cctv-panel, data-panel, radio-panel, control-panel, weather-panel, global-context-panel, scene-panel).

panelId.description: Panel ID to open or close

open.description: True to open (default), false to close

agentActions.summary: Record user acceptance of the CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 license for the 712 TeleGeography Submarine Cables dataset and toggle the layer.

accept.description: True to accept and load submarine cables, false to revoke

agentActions.summary: Ask the person's Mnemosyne OS memory a question and show the answer inside God's Eye View.

query.description: Search query for Mnemosyne OS memory

agentActions.summary: Choose what the context overlay follows: off, contacts (aircraft), flights, space-missions or missions.
List, play, stop or step through the saved director scenes.
